verses.text: Ayik toxo wal sk'och sk'uhal yik'jib'at winhaj Elías yuj Jehová t'a satcha'anh t'a skal jun chakxuxum ik', ix el winh yet' winhaj Eliseo t'a Gilgal.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a tik, yujto tzin schekb'at Jehová t'a Betel, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to ol in b'atnhej het'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil t'a Betel chi'.

Ix elta heb' winh schekab' Dios ay t'a Betel chi' scha heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi': --¿Ojtak hama to a tikne'ik ol ik'jokel winh a k'ayb'umal tik t'ayach yuj Jehová? xchi heb' winh t'a winh. --Wojtakxo, tz'inek xe chi, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winhaj Elías chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a tik, yujto tzin schekb'at Jehová t'a Jericó, xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to ol in b'atnhej het'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'atxi heb' winh schawanhil t'a Jericó chi'.

Ix eltapax heb' winh schekab' Dios ayek' ta' scha heb' winh, ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi': --¿Ojtak hama to a tikne'ik ol ik'jokel winh a k'ayb'umal tik t'ayach yuj Jehová? xchi heb' winh. --Wojtakxo, tz'inek xe chi, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winhaj Elías chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a tik, yujto tzin schekb'at Jehová t'a ha' Jordán, xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to ol in b'atnhej het'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'atnhej heb' winh schawanhil.
Najat ix b'at tzak'an 50 heb' winh schekab' Dios yuj heb' winh, najatto ix kan heb' winh t'a yichanhkot heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a sti' ha' Jordán.
Ixlajwi chi' ix spakan jun sjukan pichul winhaj Elías chi', ix spajanem winh t'a sat ha' Jordán chi'. Ix spojan sb'a ha', takinh ix aj b'aj ix ek' heb' winh t'a yol ha' chi'.

Ayik toxo ix k'axpaj ek' heb' winh chi', ix yalan winhaj Elías t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Al t'ayin tas tza nib'ej swak' t'ayach yakb'an manto in ik'jokel t'a a tz'ey, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Tzin k'an t'ayach to cha makan tz'aj ak'ankan opisio chi' t'ayin, ichato a b'ab'el unin tzin ajkan a k'exulok, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi': Te ajaltak jun tza k'an tik t'ayin. Tato ol il tas ol aj wik'jiel t'a a tz'ey, ol ak'jok t'ayach. Tato manh ol il jun, manh ol ak'joklaj t'ayach, xchi winh.

Yakb'an wan sb'ey heb' winh, wan slolon heb' winh. Elanhchamel ix cheklajk'e jun carruaje k'ak' yilji, tok'b'il yuj nok' chej k'ak' yiljipaxi. A' ix ik'anel winhaj Elías chi' t'a stz'ey winhaj Eliseo chi', ix ik'jib'at winh t'a satcha'anh t'a skal jun chakxuxum ik'.

Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix el yaw winh, ix yalan winh: Ay mamin, lajan ach icha nok' chej yet' carruaje yik owal t'ayonh israel onh tik, yujto tzach kolwajnhej t'ayonh, xchi winh. Manhxa b'aj ix yil winhaj Elías winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix snhik'chitanb'at jun spichul winhaj Eliseo ayoch yuj yik sch'oxanel skusk'olal winh.
Elanhchamel ix b'at winh sik'k'e jun sjukan pichul winhaj Elías ix kan lanhnaj chi'. Ix meltzajkan winh t'a ha' Jordán chi', ix och linhan winh t'a sti' ha'.

Ix spajanem sjukan pichul winhaj Elías chi' winh t'a sat ha ha' chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: ¿B'ajtil ayek' Jehová sDiosal winhaj Elías? xchi winh. Ixnhej em k'apak chi' t'a sat ha', ix spojan sb'a ha'. Icha chi' ix aj yek'xita winh t'a yol ha'.

Ayik ix yilan heb' winh schekab' Dios ay t'a Jericó, haton heb' winh najat linhjab'kan yila', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha yopisio winhaj Elías ix ochkan t'a winhaj Eliseo tik, xchi heb' winh. Ix kot heb' scha winh, ix em nhojnaj heb' t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Mamin, iltonab'i, ay 50 heb' winh winak t'a ko kal tik te tek'an. Tato syal a k'ol sb'at heb' winh say winh a k'ayb'umal chi', talaj ay b'aj ix aktajkan winh yuj Yespíritu Jehová t'a jolomtak witz, ma t'a yoltak ch'olan, xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Palta ix yalan winh: --Ma'ay, malaj mach sb'ati, xchi winh.
Ix ochnhej ijan heb' winh yalan t'a winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Ixikek an, xchi winh. Ix b'at heb' winh 50 chi' say t'a oxe' k'uhal. Malaj mach ix ilchaj yuj heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh t'a Jericó b'aj aykan winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tom maj wal t'ayex jun to max ex b'atlaj? xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Mamin, ilnab' wal yilji jun lugar tik, te wach', palta malaj tas tz'el t'a sat lu'um yujto manh wach'ok ha ha' ay t'a lu'um, xchi heb'.
--Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ik'ekkot atz'am atz'am t'a yol junok uk'ab' ak'to, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot jun uk'ab' atz'am chi' heb' t'a winh,

ix b'at sekanem winh t'a yol sjaj ha ha' chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ha in ix in b'o jun ha ha' tik. Manhxa b'ak'inh ay mach ol cham yuj ha', manhxa pax b'ak'inh malaj tas ol yak' t'a sat lu'um yuj ha', xchi Jehová, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'okan ha', icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a Betel. Ayik wan sk'e winh t'a sb'e'al chi', ay jun nhilanh heb' winh kelemtak ay t'a jun chonhab' chi' ix elta t'a yol sb'e winh, ix och ijan heb' winh sb'ajan winh, ix yalan heb' winh: K'e'anh ach t'en jolom. K'e'anh ach t'en jolom, xchi heb' winh.

Ix meltzajb'at k'elan winh t'a heb' winh, ix katab'aj heb' winh yuj winh t'a sb'i Jehová. Elanhchamel ix elta chawanh nok' oso t'a kaltak te', ix kotak nhik'chitajb'at 42 heb' winh kelemtak chi' yuj nok'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh t'a jolom witz Carmelo, ix meltzajxi winh t'a Samaria.
